'''Kwilaan''' was the famous [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who discovered the [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia system]] and the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. In the name of [[Elsinoré den Tasia]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]], Kwilaan led the first [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Millennia later, the explorer was remembered by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|descendants]] of those early settlers, and the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Keren/Legends|Keren's]] main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] had been named [[Kwilaan Starport/Legends|after him]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the famous [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] Kwilaan lived during the fourth millennium before the rise of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a time dominated by terrible conflicts such as the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Jedi Civil War]] and the [[Dark Wars]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3951 BBY]], the bloodbath of the Dark Wars ended,<ref name="KORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] entered a period of recovery,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> during which the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]] [[Elsinoré den Tasia]] sponsored a new age of colonization. Over the five next decades, hundreds of expeditions were launched into the so-called [[Wild Space/Legends|wild space]].<ref name="SWGB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> Around the same period, Kwilaan discovered a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="KORCG" /> located in the [[southern quadrant]] of the galaxy,<ref name="SWGB" /> which was then named the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].<ref name="KORCG" />

Around [[3900 BBY/Legends|3900 BBY]], in the final years of her reign, Tasia sponsored one last undertaking: the colonization of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="SWGB" /> the main [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the star system discovered earlier by Kwilaan. The explorer himself was tasked with leading the original settlers to their new [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="SON" /> With the blessing of a famous [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], the [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ship]] ''[[Beneficent Tasia]]'' was chartered, along with its support ships, ''[[Constant]]'' and ''[[Mother Vima]]''.<ref name="SWGB" />

After surviving many hazards, the ''Beneficent Tasia'' reached Naboo<ref name="SWGB" /> and crashed on the planet, with Kwilaan still on board. The explorer led the distraught settlers into the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] chain located on Naboo's main continent, where they founded the farming community of [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]].<ref name="Crisis">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref> Within [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of their arrival, the colonists encountered the native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], a species of land-dwelling [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]].<ref name="SWGB" /> While no records of previous Republican visits to Naboo existed, the indigenous population remained indifferent to the sudden appearance of Kwilaan's expedition, as if they had met Humans before.<ref name="KORCG" /> Although the two species instantly distrusted each other, neither resorted to violence, and the Humans were allowed to establish their first settlements without any hindrance.<ref name="THP">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

Many a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] after Kwilaan set foot on Naboo, his memory was still vivid. In [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], the most important trading [[City/Legends|city]] on the planet, the stellar-class [[Kwilaan Starport/Legends|Kwilaan Starport]] was named after him.<ref name="SON" /> The scout was also remembered on the occasion of the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]], which celebrated the day Naboo joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Through [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]] and [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] displays, the Naboo would evoke the story of their origins, and Kwilaan himself featured in his own tableau. Additionally, a [[Tapestry/Legends|tapestry]] in his image hung in the [[Theed Palace Banquet Hall|Banquet Hall]] of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Naboo Royal Palace]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="Crisis" />

==Personality and traits==
If the tapestries and holograms representing Kwilaan were accurate, the explorer was a slender, light-skinned man, and he sported a short white beard when he discovered Naboo.<ref name="Crisis" />
